messages:
maya: Quick check — SOC2 milestone: need final owners for KMS/HSM attestation evidence + audit-log pipeline gating. Who can own artifacts + handoff? Looking to close by EOD Thursday.
sam: I can take KMS evidence upload. Need list of exact artifacts + where to drop (S3 path?)
maya: List — rotation_policy.pdf, attestation_report.pdf, hsm_config_screens.png, kms-iam.csv, key-rotation-script.sh, evidence_manifest.yaml. Drop in s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/q1/<org>/maya-upload. Put a note in the manifest with PR links.
oliver: I can own audit-log pipeline gating. Backfill in progress but blocked by schema change PR 523. PR has side effects on log timestamps.
rachel: I can review PR 523 today. @oliver can you post the failing test logs? Also do we have retention proof for audit logs?
oliver: Pasted failing snippet:
```
ERROR: parse_timestamp: invalid format '03/17/26 12:03'
```
We need canonical RFC3339. Will update generator.
sam: Confirming upload path and prefix. Also need signed attestations from HSM vendor — @compliance-bot, can you confirm vendor attestation file name?
compliance-bot: Vendor attestation should be vendor_attestation_signed.pdf and include signature metadata. See /compliance/templates/attestation_template.md
maya: Great. @sam add a short checklist in the manifest: owner, artifact, location, PR link, verified_by.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll start uploading tonight. ETA tomorrow AM for most artifacts. Will paste S3 manifests when done.
oliver: After schema PR merges, I'll kick the backfill job: `./bin/audit-backfill --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-03-15` — should take ~2h on staging.
rachel: I'll do the verification run on staging after backfill and sign off. If all good, we submit evidence bundle.
maya: Thanks. One more ask: please add rotation snapshots for last 90 days (kms-rotation-90d.tar.gz). Sam, can you collect? If not, ping infra.
sam: Can collect — might need help from infra team to extract key rotation logs. I'll open infra ticket and link it here.
oliver: Opened ticket #INF-1187 — assigned to @infra-ops. Linking logs to manifest after extraction.
maya: Closing note: We'll have 1pm check-in tomorrow if any blockers persist. Otherwise we'll mark as on-track. Thanks all :pray:
